'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Gosse Zeilstra LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Gosse Zeilstra]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Gosse Zeilstra]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
